name: CoinHub Futures Trading API
description:
API for CoinHub Futures Trading Platform. This API provides endpoints for:
- Public market data (currencies, markets, order books, trades, tickers)
- User account management (balances, settings, members)
- Trading operations (orders, positions, trades)
- Administrative functions (members, markets, currencies, operations)
- Management operations (deposits, withdraws, transfers)
